name: Ash Burrower
summary: A pale, eyeless digger that swims under soft ground and bursts up beneath its prey.

sections.title: Rank and Class
sections.text: Usually a Dormant Beast: one soul core, one shard. Beasts hunt in packs, so where one surfaces, more are close.

sections.title: Habits
sections.text: Sinks into dirt, sand, gravel and ash and moves as a furrow of dust. It hunts by vibration: footsteps within a few blocks give you away.

sections.title: Weakness
sections.text: Stone stops it. It cannot burrow through stone, and a furrow that runs onto stone throws it out dazed. Sneak to hide your steps; a melee hit forces it up, arrows cannot reach it underground.

sections.title: Drops
sections.text: Ashen Hide (one or two), used at the Weaving table for hide armour, and its soul shard.
